description: ONE falsification pass of the image derivation law on the candle five-rung batch path: memory-candle-adapter run_batch on GPU 1, one model load per tier, five rungs in canonical order. observedMemory.*.activeBytes are device-VRAM deltas (bytes) above the run's idle baseline. coldStagedControl is the staged rung alone in a fresh process (the shape the packaged anchors were captured in); it isolates the batch path's warm carry-over on rung 2.

adapter.build: cargo build --release --locked -p sceneworks-memory-adapter --features candle --bin memory-candle-adapter (MSVC 14.44, CUDA_COMPUTE_CAP=120)

hardware.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

contractRestamp.method: weights-free contract read of the SAME snapshot roots named in each tier’s environment block, through the production seam (inference_runtime::media().memory_strategy_contract). No render, no device allocation, no re-measurement.
contractRestamp.why: inference c6d6a4db stopped the gen-core weight walkers recursing into the hidden .candle-device-format-v1/ cache and split the VAE encoder out of decoder_bytes into a typed ReferenceEncoder overlay. observedMemory is the ORIGINAL a5f643ae measurement and is deliberately untouched: the device the adapter measured did not change, only what the contract claims about it.
